json.query: UpdateSummary | summarize Pending = sum(if(Status == 'Needed', 1, 0)), Succeeded = sum(if(Status == 'Succeeded', 1, 0)), Failed = sum(if(Status == 'Failed', 1, 0)) by Computer
json.title: OS Upgrade Status by Computer

json.query: Heartbeat | summarize Online = countif(TimeGenerated > ago(15m)), Offline = countif(TimeGenerated <= ago(15m)) by Computer
json.title: Agent Health

json.query: Perf | where ObjectName == 'Processor' and CounterName == '% Processor Time' | summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
json.title: Performance Trends
